ei.title: Job Opportunity Outlook by Income Level Amid AI Adoption
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: The graph above shows how employed adults viewed the impact of AI adoption on their job opportunities by income level in 2024. Among all employed adults, those expecting fewer job opportunities from AI outnumbered those expecting more, while nearly a third foresaw little impact and fewer than 20% remained unaware of workplace AI use. More than one-third of lower-income workers and about one-third of middle-income workers said AI would lead to fewer job opportunities, compared to about one-fourth of upper-income workers. Over 40% of upper-income workers said AI would not make much difference, which was more than twice the share of middle-income workers who said the same. Only 5% of lower-income workers thought AI would create more jobs, while this figure rose to 8% among upper-income workers. Over one-fourth of lower-income workers had not heard of workplace AI use, which was more than three times the share of upper-income workers.

questions.passage: The graph above shows how employed adults viewed the impact of AI adoption on their job opportunities by income level in 2024. Among all employed adults, those expecting fewer job opportunities from AI outnumbered those expecting more, while nearly a third foresaw little impact and fewer than 20% remained unaware of workplace AI use. More than one-third of lower-income workers and about one-third of middle-income workers said AI would lead to fewer job opportunities, compared to about one-fourth of upper-income workers. Over 40% of upper-income workers said AI would not make much difference, which was more than twice the share of middle-income workers who said the same. Only 5% of lower-income workers thought AI would create more jobs, while this figure rose to 8% among upper-income workers. Over one-fourth of lower-income workers __________, which was more than three times the share of upper-income workers.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 하위소득 1/4 이상이 직장 AI 사용을 들어보지 못했고, 이는 상위소득의 세 배 이상
det.analysis:
❌ ① expected more job opportunities: 더 많은 기회 예상 — 1/4과 수치 불일치
✅ ② had not heard of workplace AI use: 직장 AI를 모름 — 하위소득 1/4+, 상위소득의 3배+ ← 정답
❌ ③ foresaw little impact: 적은 영향 예견 — 전체의 1/3에 해당
❌ ④ said AI would create more jobs: 일자리 생성 — 5%로 1/4과 불일치
det.tip: had not heard of = 들어보지 못했다
